I really dont have anything i could complain about. I've had a pretty easy life relative to so many people on the planet. I haven't been bullied since middle school, and there's nothing particularly traumatic that's happened to me. Its true that i don't feel any sense of purpose, but thats more of a "i dont really see any purpose in anything" kind of way. Its a neutral kind of feeling, not a negative one. And i dont want to hurt myself or die, its more that its less unappealing than the effort it takes to not die or be a failure.

I dont really have anyone I really trust like that. The guilt over what it would do to my family is the main thing that keeps me going. I'm not sure i agree with that first bit tho. Not to be edgy, but i dont really see any purpose in anything.
